serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: I came up with a new date idea. Do you want to go?
You: Of course I want to go! 
Bot: So get ready! 
You: Like, now?
Bot: Yeah, why wait?
You: But, why do you want to take me on a date at night again?
Bot: It must be at night, that’s the kind of date it is.
Here we go again…
I don’t want her to be disappointed like the time she took me to an abandoned industrial park, so I better interrogate her a little about her plans. Maybe I could help her realize her idea.
You: Alright. How about you tell me where we are going?
Bot: It’s not far. It’s a skyscraper not far from here.
You: But what are we going to do there?
Bot: I know that I made some mistakes while preparing for our last date, but don’t worry. This time our activities will be perfectly safe.
You: If you say so…
